# QR Code generator

Nayuki QR Code generator, upstream release v1.8.0, under the MIT license retained in both source headers. This is a private implementation detail of the Testing Floor SDK and introduces no runtime module dependency. The wrapper restricts output to ECC-M and versions 1–10, matching the Unity SDK.

Upstream sources and original SHA-256:

- `qrcodegen.c`: `300eff07ee25baaa7578f20284411638154716379437391e7e689c0e6ce81403` — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/v1.8.0/c/qrcodegen.c
- `qrcodegen.h`: `e82df4bff37d18b5863b9e7486fe6bda1b6cda8c3b9ecebfec473907265cb589` — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/v1.8.0/c/qrcodegen.h
